reviews.comment: Had him for Phys 206 DP. Very quirky in a good way. You can tell he's a very intelligent person, and he has a bit of wit to keep lectures entertaining. Pretty tough Exams, but the Final was a piece of cake for my class. He also curved the grading point even lower than the syllabus entailed for my class.

they say phys 207 is the hardest class but with Holt it is one of the easiest. Gives great lectures and notes are clear to follow along. Is straight forward with what he expects and exams are always sensible to what is done in class. Just do the practice exams and you will do great! he is the absolute GOAT when it comes to phys 206 and 207. he best
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is the absolute goat. An amazing person who TRULY cares so much about his students. Had him for 206 and he was so amazing and understanding. I had a rough semester mentally and it was hard, but he was so understanding. Take him one hundred percent.

Dr. Holt is HIM. he does great lecture reviews, explains topics with ease, has great material for help and is straight forward. phys in general is tough, and he knows this and makes great effort to help out and gives guidance and what to look out for the exams. no one does it like him and he did a great curve for those struggling cuz he actual care

University physics sucks but holt made it much easier. Studying is a bit tedious, but the exams are only 4 questions and you get a lot of generous partial credit from writing formulas, FBDs, etc. I did not perform very well on the final, and thought I was going to fail but there was a curve and I got out with a C. Holt is that guy.
The goat. Take this man no matter what.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Holt cares deeply cares about his students and takes time out of his weekend to do exam reviews sessions and provides you will all the necessary tools for success.

Dr. Holt is so great! Had him for PHYS 206 and 207 and he is awesome. Exams have partial credit and are similar to the practice exams from years past. His lectures are easy to follow and you can ask questions. Recitation allows for practice. No homework. Only graded on quizzes and exams. If you put in time to study for exams, class is doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Legend of a professor. He hosts exam reviews on weekends and cares a lot for his students. Don't Panic Physics 2 has been a godsend, it is so easy to get most of the credit on questions even if you don't arrive at the final answer. Be sure to study a lot outside of classes since there is no homework to boost your grade in this class. 85% is exams.

As a don't panic professor he was great. Clear lecture notes to follow and gives you everything you need to succeed. the only assignments in the class were the recitation quizzes and the exams so beware of that. Going to recitation to get clarification on concepts is a must.

Don't Panic Physics with Holt is great! He has easy-to-follow lectures, encourages participation from students, and is open to answering any questions you ever have. He responds to emails in a timely manner and has consistent office hours. He also gives lots of partial credit on exams. Physics can be tough but he does his best to make it easier!

Dr. Holt was a wonderful professor who answered questions and holds helpful (optional) review sessions. The final grade is based on exams, quizzes, and class attendance, but also has a massive curve because of how difficult the course is. His online notes are only a general outline, but he is very clear in lectures about what is expected for exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Holt has clear and concise lectures. The grading is clearly outlined and he often tells you want to expect on the tests. He has easy-to-follow lectures notes. Class quizzes about 2 times per week and a weekly recitation. Would recommend.

Professor Holt makes the best out of an annoying class. I struggled a lot with PHYS 207 because it's conceptually hard to wrap your head around some of the topics, but Holt did a great job of explaining and was very willing to help his students. 85% of the final grade is exams though, which is really my only complaint. He did give a curve though!

Dr. Holt is a great, young professor. He gives a lot of extra credit at the end of the year, which is really nice in such a difficult class, and his finals are generally easier than other professors'. Great choice for 206 or 207!

Dr. Holt is by far one of the best professors I have ever had. His lecture is well paced and well organized and he genuinely cares about his students. The tests are fair and his reviews for the test help a ton. As long as you keep up with the work you will do good. It take more work to fail the class than to pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Holt is the most organized, well-spoken, and overall best physics prof at TAMU. He has incredibly detailed lecture notes which he posts before class. He offers extra credit opportunities. He teaches us what is important, but to do well in this course you need to really focus on past exams. If you understand past exam problems, you will do well.

Could add 5 points to our final grade by wearing our mask throughout the year or completing assignments from the Dont Panic book, which is a very good deal. I always did better on the exams than I expected because of partial credit. He was pretty quick to respond to emails. Study using the past exams, and go to his office hours when you need help.

Dr. Holt is one of the best physics professors! He is extremely helpful and caring, you just have to reach out and put in your effort (hosts exam reviews before each exam!). Pay attention, be engaged, and participate during class and it is an easy C. For an A or B, attend SI and review sessions and PRACTICE previous exams!

Dr. Holt breaks down each concept into 5 easy steps. If you understand it and do a lot of past exams this class will be EASY. DON'T PANIC is a godsend (coming from the up world). There are no numbers, just variables! This sounds terrible and confusing at first but TRUST ME, it makes it so much easier. Final replaces lowest test grade. good luck!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Holt for both PHYS 206 & 207 and was lucky enough to get an A in both classes. Physics can be difficult but Dr. Holt simplified problems into easy steps. How to get an A? I didnt use the textbook at all and relied on past exams instead. I recommend you do at least 4 past exams or until you start to notice a pattern for each midterm.

Dr. Holt is the best. I struggled a lot in his class because 207 is conceptually difficult, but Dr. Holt always believed in his students. He provides step by step instructions for solving problems and explains his lectures thoroughly. A lot of inside jokes make me want to go to his class everyday. Best prof ever! He reminds me of Dr. Nodurft.

Dr. Holt is an amazing teacher. He is very clear with his lectures and he makes physics very easy to understand. He is sympathetic and takes his student's grades very seriously. I would definitely recommend him to any student who wants or needs to take physics.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr Holt is the best he reminds me of Phineas from Phineas and Ferb all grown up. If you take him online you'll likely see his cat too. He is really patient and gives great feedback. The exams are exactly like the problems we do in class and in recitation. Physics at A&M is hard regardless of professor but Holt really helps you understand it.

Dr. Holt is the best prof ever! The difficulty is for the content, not Holt (Phys 2 is conceptually hard). Great lectures; clearly answers every question asked. the class sent him a meme album of him lecturing and he loved it. Posts zoom lectures immediately but there are in class quizzes. Exams graded within 48 hours.

Dr. Holt is a fantastic professor, however the class is rather difficult. He is willing to help any student in almost any situation and shows great care in ensuring that we learn the material properly and are well prepared for exams.

Holt is probably the best professor for Don't Panic PHYS 206 (or possibly Akimov). He is very easy to understand, the material is just hard to understand until you practice it on your own. Exams can be scary at first, but his review sessions before each one help a lot. Gave a super tough final and everyone bombed it and he adjusted the grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Best phys prof ever!! He uses Don't Panic, so it won't be incredibly hard. Lecture notes are very organized, easy to follow, and with extra exam review sessions. No homework, only a short quiz weekly and has a bonus at last. The old tests helped a lot on midterms and final. He will even broaden grade ranges!! Definitely will take phys 207 with him.

I would marry this man. His lectures are great, and he uploads clear, precise and organized notes. He will do a review before tests to tell you the concepts that will be tested and provide steps to solve those types of questions. He does like 2 clicker questions every class. This is a hard class, but he is so amazing he makes it more bearable!

Dr. Holt is an amazing physics professor. This class will always require some effort, but he makes it accessible and interesting, and he tries to make the tests clear and doesn't give trick questions. The textbook wasn't helpful to me, as his lectures cover what is necessary, and he gives clear guides as to how to approach each type of problem.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is great seriously. He is really good, show up to office hours and lectures. But the down fall are his tests. They are hard.

Dr. Holt is a really good professor, you definitely will have to work at the material covered and get help when you feel you need it if you want to have any hope of passing his class. His test are fair and again as long as you study the material and practice a lot you should do just fine in his class
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Holt is honestly the best Prof Ive had so far . PHYS 208 is extremely difficult but he makes it easy. I had to work all the previous exams multiple times and spent long hours studying for this class. But if you need help go talk to Dr. holt during office hours he is super helpful and that made all the difference . I made an A but it took work.

This is a hard class. Dr. Holt is available and explains things really well. You have to do ALL of the previous exams in order to be truly prepared for the exam. I spent an average of 20 hours studying for each exam. I highly recommend this professor because he makes this difficult class as easy as possible.

Really awesome professor. Solid 10/10 guy and lecturer. Curved my final average to pass me (by like 1/2 a point tho). Attendance not technically mandatory, but clicker quizzes every class. Passed without attending the recitation or lab. TAKE NOTES, don't rely on the online notes, they wont make sense unless you go to class and take notes yourself.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: The final exam accounts for 40% of the final grade, and it can replace the lowest exam grade, so it has the potential to be worth 57% of your final grade which is ridiculous. However, Dr. Holt is a pretty good lecturer if you understand things the way he explains it. If you don't, he not very good at explaining in other ways. Daily clicker quizzes.

Dr. Holt is great. He explains things very well and cares about all his students. I would email him so much throughout the semester regarding questions on lectures and he would always answer a few moments later. You have to practice a lot to get an A in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Great lecturer all around; I didn't really need the book. The classes have clicker quizzes, which are supposed to be hard, but you get at least half credit for participating. There was an accompanying lab course and recitation, which I didn't enjoy (not to his fault), but it wasn't worth that much of the grade, so I didn't have to stress out much.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Holt is an amazing professor. I had to retake PHYS 208, but after taking it with Dr. Holt, I have a very nice understanding of fundamentals. He is very clear and easy to follow notes and takes the time to explain all of his lessons thoroughly. He always makes time in and out of class to answer questions and is very fast at replying to emails.

This class is very difficult but due to Dr. Holt and his lectures its not as bad. He is very clear to what is going to be on the exams and lectures accordingly. Compared to most physics profs he actually teaches the material instead of lecturing on useless things.

Dr Holt gives great lectures and is always willing to work with you in office hours, he is a little quick during lectures but makes sure to be clear. Make sure you bring a notebook to work out the problems and to never skip class or recitation
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took a five week summer class on material I had never learned before. Holt excelled at teaching the material to fresh eyes. He boiled the concepts down simply, and due to the short nature of the class, he skipped all the extra fluff. He showed us the formulas and how to solve them, and he prepared us for tests well.

Dr. Holt is one of the brightest physics professor on campus, and being a triple major graduate, his ability is unequivocal. The lecture material definitely helps with your understanding in that class, however, it's far from enough. If you want to pass the class, you should spend more time doing the homework and go talk to the professor.

The class itself is very difficult and requires a lot to do well, but Dr. Holt is a really good professor. His lectures are helpful, and he is always willing to meet with students outside of class with any concerns or questions they may have. If you are taking physics at Texas A&M I would definitely recommend taking Dr. Holt.

Dr. Holt is a really nice guy, had pretty effective lectures, and would always stay after class to answer any questions people had. PHYS 208 is unarguably a hard class, but Dr. Holt is definitely the professor to take.

This class definitely is hard but Holt is so great of a teacher that he wants you to succeed. Although, his jokes can be witty, they are really funny. As others have said, he is nerdy but he is great! He told us a story the first day of class and was on the final. Confused on something? Email him and he backs back to you within the hour!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Holt was a good professor. He explained things very well and made himself available to students quite regularly.  Physics is a hard course in general- make sure to study out of the book, work questions, and ask as many questions as needed for you to understand the material. The exam grades are curved but don't depend on that to pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is a great teach however, he teaches Don't Panic which is truly a pain. No matter which professor you take I highly recommend getting a tutor or going into the physics help lab to put what you learn in class into action. I would recommend going to Will Baker he has fliers all over the Mitchell Physics building.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Holt is a little nerdy, but what physics professor isn't? He knows the material well, and prepares his own slides based on the book. There is a clicker quiz or two every class. The class is hard, and you probably won't understand all of it from his lectures, but with the book it's an alright class. Holt is a pretty awesome professor, do recommend

Dr. Holt cares about his students and always is available outside of class time if you have questions. He has review sessions before the exams that are super helpful and puts all of his lecture notes online. He does mini quizzes every lecture but they're helpful for understanding the content. He's awesome.

Dr. Holt is really nice, he has daily quizzes but he does prepare his class well for the tests.  He is available outside of class and he is really helpful during his office hours.  Would definitely take him again if I could.
